decisions.label: Manual
decisions.description: A method or process performed by hand, as opposed to automation.

verification.note: NCIT:C63513 Manual; exact label match; definition 'done by hand as opposed to automation' is the correct sense for a manual de-identification method.

decisions.label: Semi-Automatic
decisions.description: A method or process performed using a combination of manual and automatic means.

verification.note: NCIT:C172484 Semi-Automatic; label hyphenates differently but is the correct NCIT qualifier for a semiautomatic de-identification process.

decisions.label: Automatic
decisions.description: Operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control.

verification.note: NCIT:C70669 Automatic; exact label match; definition 'operating with minimal human intervention' correctly describes an automated de-identification method.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.
